title: Stuffed mushroom
content:
# Stuffed mushroom

Type: Food | Internal ID: MagicallyStuffedShroom | Source: Stone oven | Usage: Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Uncooked stuffed mushroom x1 | Max Health: 25 | Max Stamina: 12 | Max Eitr: 75 | Duration: 25m | Healing: 3 hp/tick

# Introduction

Stuffed mushroom is a Mistlands-tier food.

## Recipe

Uncooked stuffed mushroom is produced in a Food preparation table with:
• 1 Blood clot
• 3 Magecap
• 2 Turnip
Stuffed mushroom is produced by cooking uncooked stuffed mushroom in a Stone oven for 50 seconds. If left in the oven for 100 seconds, it will burn and turn into Coal.

## Notes

• While stuffed mushroom is at the low end of the Mistlands tier of food, it is significantly easier to obtain than the better Eitr-boosting foods of its tier, as it is crafted from resources which are either farmable (magecaps and Turnips) or easily hunted (Blood clots). In comparison, both Yggdrasil porridge and Seeker aspic require Royal jelly, which is much harder to obtain, requiring the player to venture into Infested Mines.

Categorias: Food, Materials
